_comment: Cell descriptor for layout/bin/compose-cell.py -- see layout/README.md
section 'Composing a gate' for the floorplan reasoning shared with every
other cell, and layout/sampler_nand2/README.md for this cell's own
result.
sampler_nand2 is design/sampler_core.spice's sampler_dff subckt's
NANDM/NANDS2 gate: a plain rst_n-gated 2-input NAND2 -- a parallel PMOS
pull-up pair (Mpa/Mpb, gates a/en, sources tied DIRECTLY to vdd) and a
series NMOS pull-down pair (Mna/Mnb, gates a/en, far end tied DIRECTLY
to vss) -- structurally layout/ro_nand2/ minus its two always-on starve
devices (Mph/Mnt). Four devices total, reusing ro_nand2's own
parallel-PMOS and series-NMOS floorplan moves (mpb 'rotate_180' so its
drain faces mpa's drain; mnab as one mos_array fingers=2
finger_topology='series' call) but with NO starve devices to cross-couple
to the opposite rail, so this composes in ONE 'stages' pass fewer of
cross-coupled-gate routing than ro_nand2 needed -- the two-pass
structure below exists solely for the 3-way 'vdd' net (nwell_tap.TAP_E +
Mpa.S + Mpb.S) and 'y' net (Mpa.D + Mpb.D + Mnab.S1), whose 'far' leg
(Mpb's own S/D, on the block's far side from the tap/NMOS row) cannot be
wired in the base stage without re-crossing another block's own S/D pad
-- exactly ro_nand2's own 'py'/'y' finding, minus the starve pair's own
extra vddr/vss gate-routing legs.
mpa/mpb/mnab keep the IDENTICAL origins_um ro_nand2 uses for its own
same-shaped blocks (so the already-proven core.compose.response.json
port coordinates and final-stage waypoints_um for the 'y' net carry over
unchanged); nwell_tap/psub_tap are repositioned to abut mpa/mnab
directly (no starve device to abut instead), using klt gen's own
reported local bboxes/ports for guard_ring(add_well=true/false) and
mos_array(pfet 0.84/0.15, nfet 0.84/0.15 fingers=2 series) transformed
by each block's own orientation (none/mirror_y/rotate_180) to place
nwell_tap's TAP_E at mpa.U0_S's own y (3.74um, a direct wire once both
are promoted to the final stage) and psub_tap's TAP_E at mnab.U0_S0's
own y (0.21um, wired directly in the base stage since this 2-way net,
unlike vdd/y, has no far-side conflict -- the same reason ro_nand2's own
'ny' net, mnt.U0_D<->mnab.U0_S0, routed directly in its base stage).
